Planning Commission

06:00 PM

Encinitas, California 92024

1.

2.

3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Items 6A and 6B are located in the Coastal Zone and require the issuance of a Coastal Development Permit (CDP). The action of the Planning Commission relative to Items 6A and 6B may not be appealed to the California Coastal Commission. The Coastal Permit for Item 8C must be separately applied for and obtained from the California Coastal Commission since the project lies within the original permit jurisdiction of the Coastal Commission.
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR
6B.
PROJECT NAME: The Beacons
CASE NUMBER: 15-299 TM
APPLICANT: Valleyside Development, Inc.
LOCATION: 752-782 N. Coast Highway 101 (256-023-08)
PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider the approval of a Final Map for a mixed-use project containing four residential condominium units and four commercial condominium units.
ZONING/OVERLAY: NCM-1/North 101 Corridor Specific Plan
ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines.
STAFF CONTACT: Steve Nowak, Associate Civil Engineer: (760) 633-2 or snowak@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval
Beacons Case #15-299 FM 756 N Coast Highway 101
6C.
CANCELATION OF THE APRIL 5, 2018 PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
Cancelation of the April 5, 2018 Planning Commission Meeting
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
6A.
PROJECT NAME: Jason Street Beach Homes
CASE NUMBER: 16-075 TPM
APPLICANT: Rincon Homes, Inc.
LOCATION: 130, 132, 134 and 136 West Jason Street (254-222-13)
PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider the approval of a Parcel Map associated with four previously approved detached homes.
ZONING/OVERLAY: The project site is located in the Residential 1 (R-11) Zone and the Coastal Zone.
ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines.
STAFF CONTACT: Jesse Owens, Associate Civil Engineer: (760) 633-2780 or jowens@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval
Jason Street Beach Homes Case # 16-075 TPM DR CDP 130 W Jason St
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
SPECIAL ELECTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION VICE CHAIR
Elect a Vice-Chair
Election of Vice-Chair
8B.
PROJECT NAME: Leucadia Shell
CASE NUMBER: 17-230 PCIN
FILING DATE: October 2, 2017
APPLICANT: S&L Oil, Inc.
LOCATION: 865 Orpheus Avenue
ZONING/OVERLAY: The subject property is located in the Visitor-Serving Commercial (VSC) Zone, the Coastal Zone, and the Scenic/Visual Corridor Overlay Zone of the City of Encinitas.
DESCRIPTION: Continued public hearing to consider a Planning Commission Interpretation request regarding Encinitas Municipal Code (EMC) Chapter 30.04 (Definitions) relative to pending "Convenience Store/Mini-Mart" definition.
ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines.
STAFF CONTACT: Anna Yentile, Senior Planner: (760) 633-2724 or ayentile@encinitasca.gov
Interpret that the allowable area of a proposed convenience store/mini-mart be based on the development site area as defined by staff.
Leucadia Shell Case #17-230 PCINCR 865 Orpheus Ave
8C.
PROJECT NAME: Pacific Coast Grill Expansion
CASE NUMBER: 17-232 MINMOD/DR/PMW
FILING DATE: October 3, 2017
APPLICANT: Pacific Coast Grill (Steve Goldberg)
LOCATION: 2526 & 2530 South Coast Highway 101 (APN: 261-162-23)
ZONING/OVERLAY: The subject property is located in the Visitor Serving Commercial (VSC) Zone, the Scenic/Visual Corridor Overlay (S/VCO) Zone and the Original Permit Jurisdiction of the California Coastal Commission.
DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a Minor Use Permit Modification, Design Review Permit and Parcel Map Waiver to allow for a remodeling and expansion of an existing restaurant (Pacific Coast Grill) into a southerly adjacent restaurant space (formerly Beach House Restaurant) and associated improvements. The project includes new exterior and interior changes to both buildings, valet parking modifications, changes to the existing alcohol service license to allow service throughout both buildings, live music and entertainment, monument signage, use of temporary construction trailers and the consolidation of the underlying legal lots via a Parcel Map Waiver.
ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines.
STAFF CONTACT: Todd Mierau, Associate Planner: (760) 633-2693 or tmierau@encinitasca.gov
Recommended Action: Staff recommends approval.
Pacific Coast Grill Case #17-232 MINMODDRPMW
